tasks.description: ShortUrl entity (Id, Code, TargetUrl, CreatedAt, ClickCount) and ShortUrlConfiguration: table short_urls, unique index on Code, max lengths.
ClickEvent entity (Id, Code, OccurredAt, ReferrerHost, UserAgentFamily) and ClickEventConfiguration: table click_events, index (Code, OccurredAt).
Records CreateUrlRequest, UrlResponse, DailyClicks, ReferrerClicks, UrlStatsResponse; enum CreateStatus; record CreateResult.
IUrlRepository (TryAddAsync returns false on duplicate code, GetByCodeAsync) and EfUrlRepository using AppDbContext + IDbExecutor.
IClickAnalyticsRepository (AddBatchAsync in one transaction incl. ClickCount increments, GetStatsAsync daily/top referrers/user agents) and EfClickAnalyticsRepository.
Static UrlValidator.Validate(CreateUrlRequest): http/https absolute, <=2048 chars, no credentials; alias pattern and reserved words.
IUrlService/UrlService: CreateAsync (validation, alias, collision retry, cache warm), ResolveAsync (cache-aside), GetAsync, GetStatsAsync.
ClickRecorder : IBatchHandler<ClickEvent> writing batches via IClickAnalyticsRepository; static helpers UserAgentFamily and ReferrerHost.
MapUrlEndpoints: POST/GET /api/v1/urls, GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/stats, GET /{code} redirect (302) enqueuing ClickEvent.
Register repositories, generator, UrlService and the ClickEvent background queue; map URL endpoints.
Unit tests: code generator format/uniqueness, URL and alias validation, user-agent and referrer parsing.
Integration tests via TestApp: create 201/400/409, redirect 302/404, metadata, async click stats, parallel creates produce unique codes.
